matrix.rule: C01 bare label or single-field intent/label JSON
C02 JSON object with exactly the five schema fields
C02 unknown_flags object of booleans
C03 formatting: plain lines, no markers, blanks ignored
C03 formfill: single-field JSON {field: value}
C03 oneedit: exactly one line
controls: interpreter-rule (no dev case; contract-complete implementation; confirmation-scope only)

matrix.rule: C04 id list / JSON list; explicit empty result
C04 ordering matters only when a sort is declared
C05 TRUE/FALSE or {"decision": bool}; hedges are model failures
C06/C07/C08 bare id or single-field JSON
no positional unpacking of persisted stages (N02R root cause)
controls: structural: key-based access only in production/parser.py + interpreter.py (import- and code-audit controls)

matrix.rule: markdown fence tolerance
duplicate JSON keys are a structural defect
empty model output is its own class
substring matching never sufficient; exact token equality
controls: code-audit: single normalization point in production/parser.py

matrix.rule: parse failures are PARSER_SOFTWARE_ERROR, never model failures
typed comparison per primitive against stored truth
valid alternative solutions accepted (ties/order freedom)
structural vs semantic model failures stay distinct
unresolved disagreement -> NOT_EVALUABLE + quarantine
controls: class-discipline test (test_dualpath_waveb): every detected fault surfaces as NOT_EVALUABLE or a software class

matrix.rule: ground truth independently derivable from public payload
stored answers cross-checked, never authoritative
trusted raw artifact capture and replay
verification receipts bind trial+execution identity
duplicate trial rejection; exact resume

original_proposal_reconciliation.reconciliation_statement: The 597 GT controls are reused unchanged (they cover truth-derivation rules). They are NOT counted as substitutes for the new parser/evaluator/evidence controls: those categories are covered by the 116 dual-path witnesses, 20 production-logic faults and 6 EA08 evidence controls added here. No redundant witness inflation: two production faults are declared EQUIVALENT on the current dataset with recorded justifications rather than fake detections.
